svg.title: The Yom Kippur War: Two-Front Assault and Counter-Offensives (October 1973)
svg.desc: Pearson Edexcel GCSE History cartographic map showing the simultaneous 6 October 1973 Egyptian Suez Canal crossing under a 20 km Soviet SAM missile umbrella and Syrian armoured assault on the Golan Heights, Israel's counter-offensives toward Damascus and across the Suez Canal at Deversoir encircling the Egyptian Third Army, US and Soviet emergency resupply, and UN Resolution 338 ceasefire.

g.text: sand wall under 20 km Soviet SAM
ZOOMED INSET · SUEZ CANAL & DEVERSOIR CROSSING
The Yom Kippur War: Two-Front Assault & Counter-Crossing
